frequency_question: How often has the CCyB been raised above 0% within comparable windows of establishment or during normal economic cycles?
membership_rule: Members are G20 central banks or major banking regulators that adopted the Basel III countercyclical capital buffer framework, evaluated during comparable multi-year economic expansion phases. Excluded are emerging market adoptions with vastly different institutional histories or periods of acute systemic crisis.

cases.name: Bank of England CCyB decision window 1
Reserve Bank of New Zealand window 1

coverage_note: 10 named cases across major jurisdictions; covers the primary advanced economy implementers of the Basel III framework.
known_gaps: Excludes smaller European jurisdictions that implemented the buffer inconsistently.
validity_reason: Macroprudential institutional frameworks evolve slowly over multi-decade cycles.
